## What's new

- Wi-Fi joins routers set to WPA3. Only WPA2 was asked for, so a router set to WPA3 alone never let the Brick on, the password right or not. The same password serves both.
- Networks whose names have an accent, an emoji or a curly apostrophe in them show as themselves and can be joined.
- A 64-digit hex key works as well as a password.

---

ChaOS 2.3.2 for the TrimUI Brick and Brick Hammer.

**Install or update** with [ChaOS Installer](https://github.com/SkyWalker541/ChaOS-Installer/releases/latest), or write `ChaOS-v2.3.2-brick.img.xz` to a card yourself (that erases it).

ChaOS is built on [TortOS 2.2.0](https://github.com/ericreinsmidt/TortOS/releases/tag/v2.2.0) by Eric Reinsmidt. `ChaOS-v2.3.2-brick-sources.tar` is the source of everything in the image; what came from where is in [CREDITS.md](https://github.com/SkyWalker541/ChaOS/blob/main/CREDITS.md).
